Container.Name: birdnet-go
Container.Overview: Real-time bird species identification from audio using BirdNET deep learning models. BirdNET-Go captures and analyzes live audio from your microphone or RTSP streams, providing instant bird species identification with confidence scores. Features a web dashboard with spectrograms, audio clips, species filtering, and comprehensive detection statistics. This template uses host networking, which is recommended for new installs: multicast (mDNS) reaches the app directly. The web interface listens on the WebUI Port setting (default 8080); use 1024 or higher.
Container.DonateText: If you appreciate this work, consider supporting the developer
Container.Requires: Audio capture device (microphone, USB audio interface, or RTSP camera with audio)

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the web interface listens on. With host networking BirdNET-Go listens on this port directly; use 1024 or higher. The WebUI link in the Docker tab is expected to open port 8080 (untested on Unraid), so after changing the port browse to http://<server>:<port>

Config.Name: Sound devices
Config.Description: Sound card access for local microphone capture. Clear this on servers without a sound card (RTSP streams only)

Config.Name: Intel GPU
Config.Description: Optional: Intel iGPU render device for OpenVINO acceleration. Set to /dev/dri only on servers with an Intel GPU

Config.Name: Avahi socket (mDNS)
Config.Description: Resolve .local hostnames (RTSP cameras) through the host avahi-daemon. See the RTSP troubleshooting wiki

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: User ID for file permissions (99 = nobody user)

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: Group ID for file permissions (100 = users group)
